senses.gloss: दण्ड- + अधिप दण्ड- + अधिप, m. lord chief justice, Kathās. 25, 130.
दण्ड-धर- + अधिप दण्ड-धर- + अधिप, m. a king, Rājat. 4, 655.
दण्ड- + अस्त्र दण्ड- + अस्त्र, n. the name of a fabulous weapon, Rām. 1, 56, 9.
दण्ड- + उद्यम दण्ड- + उद्यम, m. and n. (?) severe punishment, Pañc. i. d. 421.
दण्ड- + काष्ठ दण्ड- + काष्ठ, n. a wooden staff, Śāk. 21, 1.
दण्ड-देव- + कुल दण्ड-देव- + कुल, n. a temple of the god of punishment, perhaps Yama, or a court of justice, Pañc. 128, 25.
दण्ड- + चक्रबाल दण्ड- + चक्रबाल, m. 1. the name of a fabulous weapon, Rām. 1, 29, 5. 2. A division of an army, Mālav. 9, 10.

दण्ड् दण्ड्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from the next), Par.
 1. To chastise, to punish, Man. 8, 132.
 2. To amerce (with two accus.), 9, 234.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass., दण्ड्य, Guilty, Man. 7, 20.
 --Comp.

दण्ड दण्ड (a form of दन्त्र, i. e. दम् + त्र), m. and n.
 1. A staff, Man. 8, 280.
 2. Often compounded with preceding words signifying arm, thigh, trunk, e. g. बाहु-, An arm as hard as a staff, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 11.
 3. A stem, MBh. 2, 2390.
 4. A handle, MBh. 2, 38.
 4. The staff of a banner, MBh. 2, 2079.
 5. m. A long measure, a pole of four cubits, Mārk. P. 49, 39.
 6. A staff as symbol of royal power, the sceptre of justice, etc., MBh. 12, 4485 sqq. []
 7. Symbol of energetic power, Man. 7, 102 (नित्यम् उद्यतदण्ड, Ever with raised staff, i. e. ever ready to use violence); military power, Man. 7, 101; force of arms, 7, 107.
 8. Violence, Man. 8, 72.
 9. An army, Man. 9, 294.
 10. Punishment of all kind, corporal and amercement, Man. 7, 22; 8, 274; personified, Mārk. P. 50, 26.
 11. The name of an attendant of the sun, MBh. 3, 198.
 12. A proper name, MBh. 1, 2681.
 --Comp.

दण्डक दण्ड + क, m. and n.
 1. The staff of a banner, MBh. 7, 1569.
 2. also f. का, The name of a great forest in the Dekhan, Rām. 1, 1, 39; Mahāv. 65, 11.
 3. m. pl. The name of the inhabitants of this locality, and of the locality itself, MBh. 13, 7223; Rām. 2, 21, 63.
 4. m. A proper name, Hariv. 637.
 --Comp.
दण्डन दण्ड् + अन, n. Chastising, Kām. Nītis. 13, 53.
दण्डपाशक दण्ड-पाश + क, A policeman (? perhaps -पाशिक), Pañc. 129, 1.
दण्डवन्त् दण्ड + वन्त्, adj., f. [] वती, One who has a great army, Kām. Nītis. 13, 37.
दण्डिक दण्डिक, i. e. दण्ड + इक, adj. One who chastises, MBh. 6, 439.
दाण्डिक दाण्डिक, i. e. दण्ड + इक, [] adj., f. की, Punishing; m. A chastiser, MBh. 12, 2135.

दण्डिन् दण्डिन्, i. e. दण्ड + इन्,
 I. adj. Bearing a staff, Man. 6, 52.
 II. m.
 1. Epithet of Yama, Kām. Nītis. 2, 36.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 1, 2738.
 --Comp.
दण्ड- + दास दण्ड- + दास, m. one enslaved by punishment, Man. 8, 415.

दण्ड- + धर दण्ड- + धर,
 I. adj. 1. having a mast, Rām. 2, 97, 17. 2. holding a rod as symbol of justice, chastising, Man. 9, 245; MBh. 12, 694.
 II. m. 1. a king, Ragh. 9, 3. 2. a judge, Daśak. 111, 12. 3. epithet of Yama, Rājat. 4, 655.
दण्ड-व्रत- + धर दण्ड-व्रत- + धर, adj. punishing, Bhāg. P. 4, 13, 22.
दण्ड- + धारण दण्ड- + धारण, n. punishment, Rām. 4, 17, 34.
दण्ड- + धारिन् दण्ड- + धारिन्, adj. chastising, Bhāg. P. 6, 3, 5.
दण्ड- + धृक् दण्ड- + धृक्, adj. ruling, Bhāg. P. 4, 21, 12.

दण्ड- + नायक दण्ड- + नायक, m.
 I. a judge, Hit. 66, 6. 2. the commander of a division of an army, Rājat. 7, 969.
दण्ड- + निधान दण्ड- + निधान, n. clemency, MBh. 12, 6559.
दण्ड- + नीति दण्ड- + नीति, f. the science of criminal justice, Man. 7, 43.
दण्ड- + पाणि दण्ड- + पाणि, m. 1. a name of Yama. 2. a proper name.
दण्ड- + पातन दण्ड- + पातन, n. chastising.
दण्ड- + पातिन् दण्ड- + पातिन्, adj. inflicting punishment.
दण्ड- + पालक दण्ड- + पालक, m. the chief of the police, Mṛcch. 117, 19 v. 1.
दण्ड- + भङ्ग दण्ड- + भङ्ग, m. hinderance of punishment, Bhāg. P. 6, 3, 2.
दण्ड- + मानव दण्ड- + मानव, m. a man bearing a staff, a Brāhmaṇa, Rām. 2, 32, 18.
दण्डिमुण्ड दण्डिमुण्ड, i. e. दण्डिन्-, m. a name of Śiva (bearing a staff and having his head shorn), MBh. 12, 10358.
दण्ड- + योग दण्ड- + योग, m. punishment; cf. Hit. i. d. 201, M.M. (supra, 8. 10.).
दण्ड-रुचि दण्ड-रुचि, adj. inclined to severity, Pañc. 91, 18.
दण्ड- + वाचिक दण्ड- + वाचिक, i. e. दण्डवाच् + इक, adj. performed by deeds or words, Man. 8, 6.
दण्ड- + वाहिन् दण्ड- + वाहिन्, m. a [] policeman, Daśak. 160, 1, bel.
दण्ड- + विकल्प दण्ड- + विकल्प, m. a discretionary punishment, Man. 9, 228.
दण्ड- + व्यूह दण्ड- + व्यूह, m. the array in line, Man. 7, 187.
दण्ड- + व्रत दण्ड- + व्रत, n. judicial power, Bhāg. P. 4, 13, 22.

दण्ड- + हस्त दण्ड- + हस्त,
 I. adj. bearing a staff, MBh. 6, 4959.
 II. m. 1. a staffbearer. 2. a door-keeper.
